day_local: Xuska St. Thérèse oo ah bikrad iyo dhakhtar kчи kelli ah ee Kaniisadda
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo joogitaanka Rabbiga ha idinla joogaan maanta iyo weligiisba.
penitential:
Rabbiyoow, naxariiso. Rabbiyoow, naxariiso.
Masiixoow, naxariiso. Masiixoow, naxariiso.
Rabbiyoow, naxariiso. Rabbiyoow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Waxaan rumeysanahay inaan arki doono wanaagga Rabbiga dhulka kuwa nool.
homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kaceyso oo aad dareemeyso in hawadu ay tahay mid qabow oo qoto dheer, adigoo fiirinaya kabaha yar ee ku taalla albaabka gadaashiisa, adigoo xusuusanaya tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee wiilkaaga. Maanta, adigoo jooga meeshan, waxaan eegaynaa qolka uu Benjamin Vo ku qaatay saacadihiisa aamusnaanta, halkaas oo ay ku yaalliin buugaagtiisa teknoolojiyadda, kombuyuutarradiisa, iyo sawirrada diyaaradaha uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya akhriyin buugaagta, laakiin dhisayey fikirkiisa ku saabsan nolosha. Halkaas ayaynu ka billaabaynaa maanta, annagoo aan degdegeyn, annagoo si dhab ah u eegaya noloshaas quruxda badan ee uu ilaahay inoo dhiibay mudada kooban.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa qalin iyo dhagax. Akhriska koowaad ee Job, waxaan ka maqlaynaa nin daalan oo leh: 'Oh, lahaa eraydayda waa la qori lahaa! Lahaa waxaa lagu xardhi lahaa diiwaan: In qalfoof bir ah iyo sunheebe lagu xardho dhagaxa weligiis!' Job wuxuu rabaa in xanuunkiisa la ogaado, in calaamadda xanuunka iyo rajadiisa aan la iloobin. Laakiin isla markiiba, wuxuu ku darsaday ereyadan cajiibka ah: 'Laakiin aniga ahaan, waan ogahay in Furashahaygu uu noolyahay, oo uu ugu dambeyn u istaagi doono boodhka.' 

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay xardhidda nolosha. Xusuusnow marka uu aabbihiis u sheegayey sheekooyinka khayaaliga ah, ee uu Ben si taxaddar leh u dhagaysanayey sidii iyagoo ah kuwo dhab ah. Maskaxdiisu waxay ahayd mid wax qortaysa, wax dhisaysa, oo had iyo jeer raadineysa hab uu ku fahmo adduunkan. Markaad eegto qolkiisa ama hadhaagii shaqadiisa GitHub, waxaad arkaysaa in noloshoodu aysan ahayn mid baaba'day, ee ay tahay mid lagu xardhay qalbiga qoyska.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay ahaayeen kuwo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira waqtiyo habeenkii ah oo ay codadka gurigu aamusaan, oo uu xusuustaada kusoo dhaco dhoola-caddayntii Ben markii uu ku oran jiray 'Good morning, Dad.' Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culus: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkaan si tartiib ah u joojino oo aan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. 

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka Luukas wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Ciise uu diray xertiisa laba-laba, isagoo ku yiri: 'Guri kasta oo aad gashaan, marka hore dheh: Nabadda guryahan ha ahaato.' Ciise wuxuu ku leeyahay inaan ku soconno nabaddan. Ben naftiisa wuxuu ahaa wiil bixiyay jacayl aan xisaab lahayn. Xusuusnow markii uu ahaa shan iyo toban jirka, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, wuxuuna idin leeyahay iyagoo dhoola caddaynaya inaan la idin iloobin. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow maankayga iyo qalbigayga ayaan kuu furayaa. Maadaama aanan maanta si jirmi ah kuu heli karin Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah, fadlan qalbigayga ku soo gal ruux ahaan. Igu xidh naftaada oo ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbi ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin dhowro; wajigiisa ha idiin iftiimiyo, naxariisna ha idiin soosaaro maanta iyo weligiisba. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: U ducee Ben iyo dhammaan intii naftooda bixisay, inay ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiix.
U ducee dhammaan kuwa murugaysan, in Ilaah siiyo rajada iyo qalbi qaboojinta ay u baahan yihiin.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Job wuxuu yiri: I u naxariista, i u naxariista, saaxiibbadaayow, waayo, gacanta Ilaah baa i dishay! Maxaad iigu eryaneysaan sida Ilaah oo kale, oo aad iigu cuni weyseen si dherig ah? Oh, lahaa eraydayda waa la qori lahaa! Lahaa waxaa lagu xardhi lahaa diiwaan: In qalfoof bir ah iyo sunheebe lagu xardho dhagaxa weligiis! Laakiin aniga ahaan, waan ogahay in Furashahaygu uu noolyahay, oo uu ugu dambeyn u istaagi doono boodhka; kaas oo aan anigu arki doono: indhahayga ayaa arkidoona, ee ma aha qof kale, oo jidhkayga ayaan ka arki doonaa Ilaah; gudahaygu wuxuu u engegay rabitaan.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Waxaan rumeysanahay inaan arki doono wanaagga Rabbiga dhulka kuwa nool. Maqal, Rabbiyoow, codka baryadayda; ii naxariiso oo i maqal. Qalbigaygu adiga ayuu kuu hadlayaa; indhahaygu adiga ayay ku raadinayaan. R. Waxaan rumeysanahay inaan arki doono wanaagga Rabbiga dhulka kuwa nool. Wajigaaga, Rabbiyoow, waan raadinayaa. Ha iga qarsan wajigaaga; ha iga eryin addoonkaaga cadho darteed. Adigu waxaad tahay caawiyahayga: ha igu tuurin meel fog. R. Waxaan rumeysanahay inaan arki doono wanaagga Rabbiga dhulka kuwa nool. Waxaan rumeysanahay inaan arki doono fadliga Rabbiga dhulka kuwa nool. U sug Rabbiga adkaysi leh; adkow oo sug Rabbiga. R. Waxaan rumeysanahay inaan arki doono wanaagga Rabbiga dhulka kuwa nool.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu magacaabay toddobo iyo labaatan xertiisa kale ah, wuxuuna iyagii ka hor mariyey laba-laba magaaladii iyo meel kasta oo uu damcay inuu tago. Wuxuu ku yiri iyagii: 'Goosashadu waa badantahay, laakiin shaqaaluhu waa yar yihiin; sidaa darteed ka baryada Rabbiga goosashada inuu shaqaale u diro goosashadiisa. Tag; bal eeg, waxaan idiin dirayaa sida wanka oo kale dhexda yeyda. Ha qaadan kiish lacag ah, ha kiish, ha kabo; oo ha ku salaamin cidna jidka dhexdiisa. Guri kasta oo aad gashaan, marka hore dheh: 'Nabadda guryahan ha ahaato.' Haddii nin nabadeed uu halkaas joogo, nabaddaadu waxay ku nagaan doontaa isaga; laakiin haddii kale, adiga ayay kuugu soo noqon doontaa. Guri kaas oo ku sugnow oo cun oo cab waxa ay ku siiyaan, waayo shaqaaluhu wuxuu mudanyahay mushaharkiisa. Ha ka guurin guri ilaa guri. Magaalo kasta oo aad gashaan oo ay idinku soo dhoweeyaan, cuna waxa la hor dhigo, bogsii kuwa buka oo ku dheh: 'Boqortooyada Ilaah waa idiin dhowdahay.' Laakiin magaalo kasta oo aad gashaan oo aanay idinku soo dhoweyn, u soo baxa jidadkeeda oo dheh: 'Boogaha magaaladiinna ee ku dheggan cagahayagii, xataa taas waannu idinka tuuraynaa.' Hase yeeshee tan ogow: Boqortooyada Ilaah waa dhowdahay. Waxaan idinku leeyahay, maalintaas waxay u fududaan doontaa Sodom intii ay u fududaan doonto magaaladaas.'

day: Memorial of Saint Thérèse of the Child Jesus, Virgin and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
